Directions: Based on the excerpt below and on your knowledge of social studies, answer each question that follows.
Title: “You have your Laws and Customs, so have we.”
Author:
Gachradodow
Pennsylvania, `1744`
Content: . . . Gachradodow in a strong voice, and with a proper action, spoke as follows: “Great Assaragoa, The World at the `text(first)` was made on the other Side of the Great Water, different from what it is on this Side, as may be known from the different Colors of our Skin and of our Flesh, and that which you call Justice may not be so amongst us. You have your Laws and Customs, and so have we. The Great King might send you over to conquer the Indians [Native Americans], but it looks to us that God did not approve of it. If he had, he would not have placed the Sea where it is, as the Limits between us and you. . . .

Brother Assaragoa . . . You know very well when the white people came `text(first)` here, they were poor; but now they have got lands and are by them become rich, and we are now poor: what little we have had for the land goes soon away, but the land lasts forever.” . . .
